title: Correct the PLACSP question deadline shown in planning mode
notes: The plan presented the ordinary Article 138.3 timing as definitive. Tender documents can set a different period and the response period is shorter in specified urgent procedures. An invalid tender date also normalized to a different date.
done_when: Planning labels the statutory calculation as a reference, calls out the tender deadline and legal exceptions, and omits the calculation for an invalid date.
result: Correct the PLACSP question deadline shown in planning mode
evidence: Read the current consolidated Article 138.3 and official operator guide. pnpm exec vitest run src/placsp src/cli/commands/placspPregunta.test.ts passed all 22 tests, including leap-day, invalid dates, the tender-specific cutoff, legal qualifications and refusal to send in confirmed mode.
